basis.summary: Most weight goes to paper S370's measured larval results (16L:8D best, 24D and 24L worst, rise then fall with light time), while the other two papers only claim or report background support; the 'mixed' and counterevidence claims fit the same optimum-not-maximum pattern, so I stated it as an optimum rather than a disagreement.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, moderate photoperiod and light control improved feeding: in one measured larval study, 16L:8D gave the highest feeding rate and best vigour, while constant darkness (24D) and constant light (24L) were worst, with earlier deaths. Feeding rose with light duration up to 16 h and then fell, and two other papers (one a background statement) also say suitable light helps feeding, with 300-1000 lx mentioned as favourable.
statement_zh: 对鳜类来说，适度的光周期和光照调控有利于摄食：在一项实测的斑鳜鱼苗试验中，16L:8D 摄食率最高、活力最好，而全黑（24D）和全光（24L）最差，且死亡出现更早。摄食随光照时长增加到16小时后下降，另有两篇文献（其中一篇为背景性陈述）也提到适宜光照能促进摄食，并提到300-1000 lx 光强有利于摄食。

basis.summary: Most weight rests on measured results from the larval paper S370 (the bulk of the claims) and on supportive measured results from papers S065 and S142 for juveniles; the rise-then-fall pattern in S370 and the higher-temperature optimum in juveniles are both reported as they stand, without a single optimum stated, and the descriptive claims were left out because they add no effect beyond these.

statement_en: In mandarin fish, water temperature clearly changed feeding and growth. In larvae, feeding intensity, stomach fullness and intake rose from 21°C to a peak near 25°C and then fell up to 29°C. In juveniles, 26°C and 29°C gave better weight gain and feed efficiency than 20°C, and 31°C gave the highest feed efficiency and protein efficiency ratio. The claims do not say which temperature is best for welfare.
statement_zh: 水温对斑鳜的摄食和生长影响明显。鱼苗阶段，摄食强度、饱满度和摄食量在21℃到25℃左右逐渐升高，25℃之后到29℃又下降。幼鱼阶段，26℃和29℃的增重和饲料效率高于20℃，31℃组的饲料效率和蛋白质效率最高。这些结果没有说明哪个水温对福利最好。

basis.summary: Both claims are supportive and come from different papers (2023 and 2026), but they are only stated as claims with no measured data shown, so I reported them as supportive claims without implying proven effect size; there was no disagreement to resolve.

statement_en: Two papers claim that aeration around feeding supports feeding in mandarin fish: running the aerator for an hour before the evening feed, which mixes the water and lowers surface temperature, and a dual aeration mode, which also evens out dissolved oxygen in the water. Both are stated as claims without measured results in the text given, and neither reports any disagreement or lack of effect.
statement_zh: 两篇文献都认为摄食期增氧有利于鳜鱼摄食：一是傍晚投喂前1小时开增氧机，促进水体上下交换、降低表层水温；二是采用双重增氧模式，同时让水体溶氧更均匀。这两条都只是文中的论断，所给内容里没有实测结果，也没有出现不一致或无效的说法。

basis.summary: I relied mainly on the measured claims, especially the spotted mandarin fish larvae data (S370), the stomach-emptying data (S419), and the Korean S065 and S142 trials, with background claims only as support; I reported the null and non-monotonic results as disagreement rather than smoothing them over.

statement_en: Across the claims, water temperature affects feeding in mandarin fish and related Siniperca species: measured results show feeding and feed efficiency generally rise with warmer water up to an optimum, then fall, with stomach emptying slower at 18℃ and highest feeding activity at about 26-30℃ in one study and 25℃ in spotted mandarin fish larvae. The measured results are not uniform: one study found no difference in daily feed intake across its range, and another found higher intake at 27℃ and 33℃ than at 29℃ and 31℃.
statement_zh: 从这些结果看，水温会影响鳜类的摄食：实测多显示在一定范围内水温升高，摄食和饲料效率上升，超过适宜温度后下降；18℃时胃排空很慢，一项研究中26-30℃摄食最活跃，斑鳜鱼苗则在25℃摄食率和饱食率最高。但结果并不一致：有研究在试验温度范围内日摄食率没有显著差异，另一项研究中27℃和33℃组的摄食量反而高于29℃和31℃组。

basis.summary: The two measured claims (C15677, C7915, from two papers) carry the most weight because they report improved feeding intensity and feed-training rate; the other six come from four papers and are claimed or inferred only, and none disagree, so I summarised them as consistent but mostly unmeasured.

statement_en: All eight claims are supportive: shading over feeding platforms, cages or training ponds is said to reduce the negative effect of strong light on feeding, and two measured claims report higher feeding intensity and a higher rate of acceptance of dead feed (feed-training rate) in training ponds. Most of the other claims are statements without measurements, and they describe shading as shifting feeding to dawn and dusk or dim conditions, or as preventing algal blooms and turbid water; no claim reports no effect or a negative one.
statement_zh: 8条结论都是正面的：在食台、网箱或驯化池上方遮阳遮荫，据称可减轻强光对鳜鱼摄食的不利影响；其中两条有实测的结果显示，驯化池加盖遮阳网后摄食强度提高、驯食率提高。其余多为未经测定的说法，称遮阴可让鳜鱼在黎明、黄昏或较昏暗的环境下摄食，或避免蓝绿藻爆发和水体混浊影响摄食；没有结论报告无效或不利的结果。

grouping.reason: All members describe using flushing or water flow in cages to induce shoaling and feeding in mandarin fish, with differences only in equipment or timing, so they are one practice.

basis.summary: All 11 claims from 11 papers point the same way with no disagreement, but only a few are marked measured and they describe the setup or observed gathering rather than a quantified welfare effect, so I kept the wording general and noted that most claims describe the practice.

statement_en: All 11 papers describe flushing water as helping mandarin fish start feeding: water flow draws the fish into groups to wait for food and is said to encourage feeding, especially in the low-appetite early stage of training onto feed. Several papers measured or applied it, but the claims mostly describe the setup and how it is used rather than reporting a quantified effect, and none report a negative or null result.
statement_zh: 11篇文献都认为冲水有助于鳜鱼开口摄食:水流信号能让鳜鱼集群等待投喂,在饲料驯化初期摄食欲望低的阶段尤其被认为能促进摄食。其中有几篇是实测或实际使用,但多数只是介绍装置和用法,没有给出量化的效果,也没有文献报告负面或无效的结果。

basis.summary: Both claims come from a single paper and are inferred rather than measured, so I stated them as the authors' interpretation; C6393 (marked counterevidence) carries the welfare effect on feeding and C6395 only adds a descriptive explanation.

statement_en: In one 2015 paper on mandarin fish, the authors infer that glucose solution treatment in early life weakened the larvae's ability to feed, so they could not catch feed fish and grew slowly. They also infer that these weak feeders relied mainly on protein- and fat-rich feed fish, which explains low GK expression in one group; neither effect is directly measured in the claims.
statement_zh: 在一篇2015年的鳜鱼研究中，作者推测早期用葡萄糖溶液处理会削弱仔鱼的摄食能力，导致它们抓不到饵料鱼、生长缓慢。作者还推测，这些摄食能力弱的鱼主要靠蛋白和脂肪含量高的饵料鱼为食，以此解释FF-3组GK表达偏低；这两点在这些结论中都只是推断，并非直接测定。

statement_en: Both claims, from two papers, say micro-flow or running water cultivation in hatching tanks helped mandarin fish fry feed: it was better than still water and helped fry swallow bait fish, and it was beneficial for the first feeding of weak larvae. No claim reports a negative or null result, and conditions beyond the hatching tank setting are not given.
statement_zh: 两篇文献都认为孵化缸/孵化环道里用微流水或流水培育对鳜鱼苗摄食有帮助：流水比静水效果好，有利于鱼苗吞食饵料鱼，对体质较弱的鱼苗开口摄食也有好处。没有结果显示不利或无效，除孵化设施条件外也没有给出其他条件。

statement_en: Three papers say micro-flow water helps feeding in mandarin fish and related fish: it improves group feeding of fry at high density in small tanks, makes dead bait move so fish will take it during feeding training (reported for spotted mandarin fish, 斑鳜), and, at 0.1-0.2 m/s with a rotating flow, aids active feeding and survival. One paper infers that flow stimulates appetite and raises intake. All four claims are supportive and none report no effect, but they are stated or inferred rather than shown with measured data.
statement_zh: 三篇文献都认为微流水有利于鳜摄食：小水体、高密度下可提高苗种集群摄食效果；用潜水泵造微流水让死饵料水平运动，可引诱斑鳜摄食、用于驯食；0.1-0.2米/秒的旋转微流水利于活动摄食并提高成活率。另有一篇推断水流刺激可促进食欲、增加摄食量。四条结论都是正面的，没有无效或相反的结果，但都是作者的说法或推断，没有给出实测数据。

statement_en: In one study on mandarin fish, under three photoperiods (8L:16D, 12L:12D and 16L:8D), feeding rate, gut fullness, satiation rate, food intake, feeding intensity and growth in body weight, length and eye diameter all rose as water temperature went up. A second claim from the same paper only describes the aim of the work, so it adds no effect on welfare.
statement_zh: 在一项斑鳜研究中，8L:16D、12L:12D和16L:8D三种光周期下，随着水温升高，摄食率、消化道饱满度、饱食率、摄食量、摄食强度以及体重、全长和眼径的增长率都增加。另一条结论只是说明该研究的目的，没有给出对福利的影响。

statement_en: Six papers describe controlling water exchange for mandarin fish, mostly as frequent small exchanges (for example under 10% per exchange, 10-20% of pond water, about 1/6 daily, 2-3 or 5-7 times a day) to keep water quality fresh. They present this as supportive of water quality, but the figures differ between papers and almost none report a measured welfare outcome.

basis.summary: C13474 carries the most weight because it is a measured result, though it shows harm from cooling in a cold range and not a water quality outcome, while C15025 only describes a cooling method without measured effect, so the two are not directly comparable and I noted the difference.

statement_en: For mandarin fish, one measured study found that cooling water from 14.5°C to 7.5°C was followed by reduced feeding, a higher feed conversion ratio, lower condition factor, and weaker antioxidant, immune, digestive and liver function. A second paper only describes lowering water temperature in the hot season by deepening the water and adding shade shelters, and reports no measured effect on water quality or welfare.

statement_en: All ten claims describe water change as a way to keep water quality good, and none report a negative or null effect. They vary in how much and how often water is changed, from partial changes every 2–3 days to daily partial or full changes. One measured claim says daily water change and cleaning kept ammonia nitrogen below 0.6 mg/L and nitrite below 0.2 mg/L; two claims say to change water when quality indicators stay high and cannot otherwise be treated, provided the water source is safe.

statement_en: In one pond study of high-density mandarin fish, adding photosynthetic bacteria (and, in a separate group, nitrifying bacteria) improved water quality compared with the control: pH was lower, and nitrite, ammonium nitrogen, total phosphorus and total nitrogen were significantly lower in both treated groups. The results were partly mixed: nitrite in the PSB group first rose and then dipped slightly, and ammonia in the PSB group rose sharply, which the authors attribute to excess ammonia harming the bacteria, so the water improvement is described as partial.
statement_zh: 在一项高密度鳜鱼池塘试验中，投加光合细菌（另设硝化细菌组）后，水质总体好于对照组：pH较低，两个处理组的亚硝酸盐、氨氮、总磷和总氮都显著低于对照。但结果并不完全一致：光合细菌组的亚硝酸盐先升后略降，氨氮还出现急剧上升，作者认为可能是氨氮过高影响了光合细菌，所以水质只是部分改善。

statement_en: Five papers say that applying quicklime to mandarin fish ponds helps water quality: it raises and steadies pH, adds hardness and alkalinity, and so may reduce stress from pH swings. These are stated or background claims, not measured results; one paper describes a schedule (every 20 days, 15–20 kg per mu), and one is about crabs, not mandarin fish.
statement_zh: 五篇文献都认为在鳜鱼池塘泼洒生石灰有利于水质：可以提高并稳定pH，增加硬度和碱度，从而可能减轻pH波动引起的应激。这些都是文献中的论述或背景说法，并没有实测结果；其中一篇给出了用法（每隔20天全池泼洒一次，每亩15至20公斤），另一篇说的是河蟹而不是鳜鱼。

statement_en: Two papers describe applying quicklime and fertilizer in mandarin fish ponds, with the stated aim of improving water quality: quicklime to adjust pH, compound fertilizer to promote phytoplankton for better dissolved oxygen and water quality, and (in the second paper) quicklime with fermented organic manure to optimise the water environment. Both are stated purposes only, and neither claim reports a measured effect on water quality or welfare.
statement_zh: 两篇文献都提到在鳜养殖池塘中施用生石灰和肥料，目的是改善水质：生石灰用来调节pH，复合肥用来促进浮游植物生长、改善溶氧和水质；另一篇则是在生长旺季定期施用生石灰和发酵有机肥来优化水环境。这些都只是说明用途，没有给出水质或福利方面的实测效果。
